annotations.title: Escrever as mensagens da pessoa de exemplo

description: Writes the messages of ONE example person of the campaign from its current template and returns them, to show how the template reads before the other people's messages are written again. Not read-only: the new messages replace that person's unsent ones (sent and hand-edited messages are kept). Nothing is sent to anyone. It picks the person itself (one with a buying signal when there is one) and keeps the saved messages, so they are not paid twice. A second call in the same conversation turn returns the first result. The result's messagesOutdated counts the other people whose messages still come from the earlier template. Free.
name: preview_campaign_messages
title: Escrever as mensagens da pessoa de exemplo
